subject: URGENT: Deviation Notification - Batch ATC-2026-B089 Residual Solvent OOS on CVD-04
content:
QA Investigations Team,

Please log an immediate investigation for Atorvastatin Calcium Trihydrate batch ATC-2026-B089 produced in Sterile API Block B, Room 204.

During QC release testing today (2026-10-24), residual acetone tested at 5,840 ppm (Repeat test: 5,815 ppm) against specification limit of NMT 5,000 ppm.

Preliminary shift log review indicates the vacuum drying process on Conical Vacuum Dryer CVD-04 was terminated after 14.5 hours instead of the SOP-PRD-502 mandated 18.0 hours because the operator responded to an intermittent high-condenser temperature warning alarm (chilled water return recorded at 18.4°C vs limit of 15°C).

Batch ATC-2026-B089 (6 drums, 312.4 kg) has been placed under quarantine in Bay 3. Equipment CVD-04 is locked out. Laboratory testing error has been ruled out.

Please proceed with AI-assisted Root Cause Analysis immediately.
